title: Shuffle to Buffalo
mainIdea: Practice and confidence helped Amelia overcome her fear and succeed in her dance recital.

pages.text: Amelia had a tap dance recital and wanted to do her best.

question.text: Who is the main character in the story?

pages.text: Amelia wanted to perform her solo dance well at the recital.

options: To skip the recital and stay at home

pages.text: Amelia worried that everyone would notice if she made a mistake during her solo.

options: She forgot her costume at the dance studio
She was nervous about making mistakes

pages.text: Amelia practiced everywhere and kept dancing even after making one small mistake.

question.text: What did Amelia do to solve the problem?
options: She stopped dancing after making one small mistake
She practiced and continued dancing confidently
She left the stage and asked her mom to take her home

pages.text: The audience applauded, and Amelia was proud because her recital was a success.

options: Amelia quit dancing and walked off the stage before her solo
Amelia performed successfully and felt proud of herself
The recital was canceled because the hall was too crowded

elements.correct: To perform her tap dance solo successfully
distractors: To win first prize at the singing contest
To skip the recital and stay at home with Mom

elements.correct: She was nervous about making mistakes on stage
distractors: She was late and could not find her dance costume
She was tired from dancing all week long

elements.correct: She practiced everywhere and stayed confident
distractors: She stopped dancing and watched from the seats
She asked her teacher to change her solo

elements.correct: She finished the recital and felt proud
distractors: She quit dancing before her solo
She forgot her whole routine on stage
